vintage: 2022 Q3–2026 Q2; 15 reporting editions with earlier comparison periods
title: Domestic government debt by instrument
description: Domestic government instruments across all 15 listed quarterly editions, including original USD and USD-million/LKR-billion reporting units.
grain: One reported numeric cell per source table row, period, metric and unit.
notes: PDF page numbers are 1-based physical pages, not printed page labels.
Source dashes and ND remain null, never inferred zero. Source totals and components overlap; value is not additive.
caveats: Bills include interest. Amounts are positions, not new borrowing. Historical reporting perimeters and classifications change; comparison-period revisions remain separate by reporting_period. No Q4 2022 bulletin is listed; December 2022 appears as a comparison in Q1 2023. Earlier tables use USD, not USD million.
Selected reviewed tables and rows; this is not a complete extraction of the publication or historical archive. Source footnotes and definitions remain authoritative.
